why_now: The five registered engineering preconditions for a same-budget online development panel are now satisfied and independently archived (P-LIVE-QUALIFY-FULL-v1: resume parity, complete whole-fleet energy ledger, commitment immutability, unrevealed-mutation invariance, full 10s submit path - all with fail-able controls). Registering the panel BEFORE implementing the arm keeps the protocol genuinely prior to the data.
question: At matched per-day wall budget and matched ACTUAL decoder calls, does a pickup masked-reconstruction arm that consumes the frozen CVRP encoder+decoder raise A-v1 utility over (a) the registered cond_hist baseline, (b) a same-initial-value reconstruction-only control whose decoder output is discarded, and (c) the qualified strong rolling controller under the same contract?

input_contract.packet_protocol: P-LIVE-QUALIFY-FULL-v1 (public packet via live_snapshot.capture, validated by live_snapshot.validate_packet)
input_contract.adapter_to_adapt: C-VRP_Cold-chainVehicleRoutingProblem/scripts/delivery/delivery_maskco.py::MaskCORouteProvider (encoder+decoder load pattern reused; pickup objective and feasibility replaced)
input_contract.adapter_reuse_rule: Reuse the checkpoint-loading and prewarm pattern only. The pickup feasibility gate, objective and certification path are A-v1 and MUST NOT be replaced by the delivery contract cost.

registered_arms.maskco: pickup masked reconstruction: mask a registered fraction of revealed, unserved orders; retain unmasked edges via partial_adjacency; one decoder call per cycle; insert masked orders by regret-2 scored with the decoder logits as a guide term plus distance; certify each candidate under the A-v1 hard gates (C0 energy budget B, TW, capacity, commitments, fish salability); accept only on certified utility improvement
registered_arms.recon_only: SAME initial value, SAME mask schedule, SAME number and timing of decoder calls, but the decoder output is DISCARDED and insertion is scored by distance only - the same-initial-value reconstruction-only control required by the pickup main gate
registered_arms.discard_control: pays one identical decoder call per step and discards it entirely, so consumed compute is matched while information value is removed; this is the control whose absence invalidated the earlier D-DESTROY-v1 panel
registered_arms.strong_rolling: the qualified strong rolling controller (RollingOptimizeReplanner) under the same A-v1 contract and the same per-day wall budget to spend on its own search
registered_arms.cond_hist: the registered conditional-history baseline the pickup main gate names

matched_resources.actual_decoder_calls_per_arm: MUST be asserted equal across arms from the run's own counters, never assumed
matched_resources.note: matching every resource the treatment consumes is mandatory; an arm that consumes more compute is not a matched comparison
matched_resources.measured_constraint_from_qualification: exhaustive re-ordering enumeration fits only subproblems of <=3 orders inside the 10s barrier (see pickup tree node n5). The masked-reconstruction arms above use decoder calls plus greedy insertion rather than exhaustive enumeration, so their per-decision cost must be MEASURED, not extrapolated from the enumeration result.

qualification_required_before_the_panel_: the pickup adapter passes the same read-only inference identity qualification used for delivery (D-INFERIDENT-v1): determinism within and across processes, and MANDATORY positive controls that the supplied adjacency changes the logits and that the real checkpoint differs from a random same-architecture model
inference provably does not mutate the frozen parameters
no arm may read unrevealed orders: the packet validator plus a future-mutation invariance check on every decision point

data_plan.dev_split: fresh seed; complete days; disjoint from every seed already used in either cycle

registered_seeds.dev_instance_count: to be fixed in the run registration, before data

data_plan.seed_freshness_evidence: the four registered seeds matched NOTHING in the workspace at registration time (ripgrep over the whole workspace and over the extension for all six candidates including 2026120213 and 2026120221 returned no matches)
data_plan.confirm_split: NOT part of this protocol; confirmation requires three fresh 40-complete-day cohorts under its own protocol with alpha_total = 0.05/(j(j+1)) split across pickup/delivery and Bonferroni across registered contrasts and cohorts
forbidden: reusing any instance id or seed already observed in either cycle
reading a confirmation cohort before the development panel is frozen
any successful-condition resampling, seed shopping, or dropping incomplete states

program_main_gate_restated_verbatim.threshold: the pickup MAIN gate requires the new method minus cond_hist to be >= 20 utility/day with a paired CI lower bound > 0, AND the difference from the same-initial-value reconstruction-only control to have mean > 0 with a paired CI lower bound > 0, AND a comparison against a qualified same-contract strong rolling controller
program_main_gate_restated_verbatim.why_restated_here: the development gates below are DELIBERATELY LOOSER than this main gate. Development gates exist only to select a candidate; passing them is NOT passing the main gate, and a mean above zero is far below the >= 20 utility/day threshold. Recording both makes that confusion impossible.

development_gates.g1_vs_cond_hist: maskco - cond_hist mean utility per day > 0 AND paired instance-level bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 (DIRECTIONAL SELECTION ONLY - this is NOT the main gate, which additionally requires >= 20 utility/day)
development_gates.g2_vs_recon_only: maskco - recon_only mean > 0 AND paired CI lower bound > 0 (the same-initial-value reconstruction-only contrast; the main gate states the same direction but carries the >= 20 utility/day threshold on the cond_hist contrast)
development_gates.g3_vs_strong_rolling: maskco - strong_rolling reported with a paired interval; the main gate additionally requires comparing against a qualified strong rolling controller under the same contract
development_gates.g4_vs_discard: maskco - discard_control reported, to separate information value from throughput
development_gates.status_of_these_gates: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. These gates select at most one frozen candidate. They confer no confirmatory status and no alpha, and satisfying them does NOT satisfy the program main gate restated above.
development_gates.no_equivalence_claim: a CI spanning zero means the difference is not established, never equivalence; no equivalence boundary is registered here
development_gates.multiplicity: development selects one configuration only; the confirmatory alpha is declared in the separate confirmation protocol and no re-selection is permitted after seeing confirmation numbers

required_artifacts: every public packet per decision point and every candidate evaluation
best and baseline full typed traces with independent terminal replay of the full A-v1 utility
C0 contract hash, dataset hash, and actual source/weight start and end SHA
actual decoder-call counts per arm, per-phase wall seconds, and every timeout or failure retained
the mask schedule and its RNG seed, and the frozen candidate configuration

explicit_non_claims.note: the panel shares the versioned C0 evaluator; its physics is not independently calibrated. A negative result cannot close the action space or other untested methods.

a frozen component must be qualified with positive controls or the comparison may measure an inert channel (D-INFERIDENT-v1, delivery tree n3)
